title: OpenAI Introduces Businesses in ChatGPT: Verified Business Hub, Direct Discovery & Autonomous Business Agents
summary: OpenAI has officially unveiled 'Businesses in ChatGPT'—introducing a dedicated Business Hub, verified badges, live product feeds, webmaster analytics, and conversational Business Agents that allow customers to research products and make inquiries directly within ChatGPT.
content:
OpenAI has officially launched **Businesses in ChatGPT**, representing a major strategic expansion from pure conversational AI and web search into direct business discovery and conversational commerce. The new platform enables companies to claim verified profiles, showcase real-time product catalogs, access privacy-preserving webmaster insights, and deploy dedicated conversational Business Agents.

Here is a comprehensive breakdown of the new features, architecture, and step-by-step instructions on how companies can claim, verify, and launch their presence on ChatGPT.

### 1. The ChatGPT Business Hub: Verified Command Center

The central pillar of the announcement is the **ChatGPT Business Hub** ([chatgpt.com/business-hub](https://chatgpt.com/business-hub)), a web console where founders, business owners, and authorized representatives can claim and manage how their business is represented across ChatGPT.

• **Blue Verified Checkmark Badge**: Claimed and verified businesses receive an official blue verified badge displayed across search results and profile cards, confirming authenticity.
• **Authoritative Company Metadata**: Businesses can curate operating hours, physical locations, customer service policies, warranty terms, and official support links.
• **Dynamic Product & Catalog Feeds**: Companies can upload structured product feeds containing real-time pricing, stock availability, specifications, and direct checkout links.
• **Priority Search Crawling**: Grounded via OpenAI's dedicated crawler (`OAI-SearchBot`), ensuring that product availability and pricing are indexed accurately.

### 2. Conversational Business Agents: Direct Customer Interaction

For eligible e-commerce and online brands (initially launching in beta across the United States), OpenAI introduced **Business Agents**.

• **Dedicated Interactive Experiences**: Customers searching for products can choose to launch a separate, clearly labeled conversational session powered directly by the brand's verified catalog and policies.
• **High-Nuance Advisory**: Shoppers can ask specific questions (e.g., *'Will this jacket fit a 6 foot 2 frame with long arms?'* or *'What is the warranty coverage for this espresso machine?'*) and receive answers grounded strictly in the merchant's official documentation.
• **Strict Consumer Privacy**: OpenAI enforces rigorous privacy boundaries—individual consumer chat logs, identities, and private conversations are never shared with the business.

### 3. Webmaster Analytics: Privacy-Preserving Discovery Metrics

Similar to search console tools, the Business Hub provides brand owners with aggregate analytics detailing how users discover their products in ChatGPT:

• **Business Mentions**: Aggregate count of how often the company's brand or products are cited in ChatGPT answers.
• **Website Click-Throughs**: Real-time tracking of recorded clicks leading from ChatGPT citations directly to the company's website.
• **Discovery Topics**: Trend analysis highlighting the key conversational categories, consumer questions, and product themes where the business is cited.

### 4. Step-by-Step Setup Guide: How to Claim & Verify Your Business

Follow these sequential steps to claim your organization's listing, pass verification, and configure your presence:

• **Step 1: Access the Business Hub**: Navigate to [chatgpt.com/business-hub](https://chatgpt.com/business-hub) and sign in using the ChatGPT account you wish to designate as the primary manager.
• **Step 2: Search or Create Your Business**: Use the search bar to locate your existing business profile (frequently pre-indexed for physical stores and restaurants). If you are an online store or SaaS company without an existing card, click to register a new listing.
• **Step 3: Complete Connection Verification**: Prove authorized representation through one of the supported verification channels: DNS TXT record insertion in your domain registrar (Cloudflare, GoDaddy, Namecheap), matching corporate email domain verification, official phone call/SMS, or direct Shopify store authentication.
• **Step 4: Pass Persona Identity Verification**: To prevent impersonation, the designated business representative must complete a biometric identity check via **Persona**, providing a valid government-issued photo ID and a brief live camera scan.
• **Step 5: Configure Business Profile & Product Feeds**: Once approved, upload your logo, operating hours, return policies, and product catalog feeds. Verify that your web server does not block `OAI-SearchBot` in your `robots.txt`.
• **Step 6: Deploy & Test Your Business Agent**: If eligible for the beta, configure your conversational Business Agent with custom instructions, test question flows, and activate it for live consumer queries.
• **Step 7: Monitor Mentions & Referrals**: Use the Business Hub analytics dashboard to track brand citations, referral clicks, and emerging discovery topics.

### Official Sources & Information References

All details, architecture specifications, and verification workflows were verified from the following official sources:

• **OpenAI Official Announcement**: [openai.com/index/introducing-businesses-chatgpt](https://openai.com/index/introducing-businesses-chatgpt/) — Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT official blog release.
• **ChatGPT Business Hub**: [chatgpt.com/business-hub](https://chatgpt.com/business-hub) — Official portal for business verification, profile curation, and agent deployment.
• **OpenAI Help Center**: [help.openai.com](https://help.openai.com/) — Official documentation for Business Hub verification methods, Persona checks, and crawler settings.
